theme.title: Appearance
theme.description: Choose light or dark. "System" follows your OS setting automatically.

color.title: Color theme
color.description: Choose a color palette for the interface.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the interface language. "System" follows your OS language automatically.

ui.title: UI font
ui.description: Font used for the app interface (menus, buttons, sidebars, etc.).

article.title: Article font
article.description: Font used for novel prose — scene writing and chapter reading.

customProviders.title: Custom model providers
customProviders.description: Define custom LLM providers in the same JSON format as models.dev. Merged into the built-in catalog; entries here win on id collision. Save empty to clear.
customProviders.entryWarnings: {{count}} invalid entries will be skipped at load: {{ids}}

webSearch.title: Web search
webSearch.description: Choose the search engine used by the agent's web_search tool.

exa.name: Exa
exa.description: Keyless ~50/day; with a key, $10 free monthly credit

webSearch.keyRequiredHint: This engine requires an API key — searches will fail without one.
webSearch.keylessHint: Without a key, uses the keyless tier (~50 searches/day, no proxy needed)
webSearch.saveFailed: Failed to save web search settings
webSearch.loadFailed: Failed to load web search settings

verbosity.label: Log verbosity
verbosity.help: Switch to Verbose when troubleshooting. Very verbose is for developers only.

clear.confirmDescription: This permanently deletes every historical log file except today's. This cannot be undone.
